subscription_promotions.name: Claude artifact usage promotion
subscription_promotions.scope: Free (from October 7), Pro, Max and Team; excludes Enterprise. Eligible Claude chats and cloud tasks in the Claude app only.
subscription_promotions.benefit: 50% less five-hour session usage for eligible artifact work; approximately 2x eligible session capacity, not a blanket token discount.
subscription_promotions.limits: Chat: next 10 messages after an artifact edit, up to the first 15 steps per reply. Cloud tasks in the Claude app: about 45 minutes when starting with Document, Presentation or Design, or up to 80 steps after an artifact edit.
subscription_promotions.exclusions: No Claude API, Claude Code, local desktop tasks in the Claude app, scheduled/unattended tasks, usage-credit charges, older artifacts, standalone Claude Design, or Google Drive-created Docs/Sheets/Slides. Weekly allowance is unchanged.
subscription_promotions.recommendation: For eligible document, slide and design work, consider Claude during this offer to stretch the five-hour allowance. Choose the lowest model and effort that passes your checks. API benchmark costs do not measure subscription allowance; no cross-vendor subscription winner is established.
